summary: Cenntro Inc. filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement dated October 9, 2026, with Pacific Century Securities, LLC as sales agent. The company may sell up to $100,000,000 of common stock from time to time on the Nasdaq Capital Market under Rule 415(a)(4); the agent earns a 3.5% commission, with expense reimbursement capped near $100,000. This is an ordinary shelf/ATM takedown rather than a special situation; no price or premium is stated, and no board recommendation beyond the agreement itself is disclosed. What to watch: dilution pace, share price overhang, and Nasdaq minimum-price compliance risk.
